moves.label: Quick Tsurugi Jab
moves.description: Fast high sword jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Compact high blade check.

moves.label: Low School Flip
moves.description: Fast low flip kick with long active coverage and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Low kick drops into a flipping leg attack.

moves.label: Tsurugi Body Thrust
moves.description: Quick mid sword thrust with a short active window and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Forward blade thrust hits at body height.

moves.label: Otokojuku Sword Arc
moves.description: Fast mid sword arc with very long active coverage and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Broad sword swing and arc effect cover mid space.

moves.label: Tsurugi Guard Cut
moves.description: Slow mid guard cut with a long active wind-up and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Delayed grounded sword cut.

moves.label: Sword Thrust Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with long active sword reach and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward sword thrust is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Driving Sword Arc
moves.description: Fast mid sword arc with very long active pressure and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Command reuses the broad mid sword-arc kick family.

moves.label: Low Tsurugi Feint
moves.description: Slow low feint with moderate active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Low sword-step feint stays near the legs.

moves.label: Low Jumping Blade
moves.description: Slow low jumping knockdown kick with extended active time and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Low jump attack flips forward and is authored as knockdown.

moves.label: Otokojuku Tornado Crush
moves.description: Slow mid jumping tornado that knocks down after a strong sword spin.
moves.reason: Upward spin has tornado, jump, and knockdown data.

moves.label: Crouching Aura Dash
moves.description: Fast mid crouching dash with very long active aura pressure.
moves.reason: Blue-yellow crouch dash effect drives forward at mid height.

moves.label: Crouch Sword Launcher
moves.description: Steady mid launcher with a tiny active sword pop-up and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Crouch-to-thrust hit is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Overdrive Tsurugi Jab
moves.description: Fast high overdrive jab with a short active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Overdrive command uses the quick sword jab.

moves.label: Otokojuku Aura Drive
moves.description: Slow special knockdown drive with very long active sword pressure.
moves.reason: Aura drive is authored as a special knockdown.

moves.label: While-Rising Sword Thrust
moves.description: Slow mid while-rising thrust with a brief active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: While-rising command uses a mid sword thrust.

moves.label: Rising Tsurugi Arc
moves.description: Fast mid rising sword arc with very long active coverage and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Rising command sweeps through a wide sword arc.

moves.label: Ducking Tsurugi Jab
moves.description: Fast high ducking sword jab with a short active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Down jab reuses the quick sword jab.

moves.label: Diagonal Sword Launcher
moves.description: Slow mid launcher with a tiny active pop-up and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Diagonal thrust is authored as a launcher.

moves.label: Forward Sword Rush
moves.description: Fast mid forward rush with very long active sword pressure.
moves.reason: Forward command rushes through repeated sword arcs.

moves.label: Forward Sword Thrust
moves.description: Slow mid forward thrust with a brief active window and quick recovery.
moves.reason: Forward command uses the mid sword thrust.

moves.label: Tsurugi Rush Jab
moves.description: Fast high rush jab with a short active window and heavy recovery.
moves.reason: Quarter-circle jab reuses the quick sword jab.

moves.label: Otokojuku Burst Slash
moves.description: Steady mid knockdown burst with very long active sword coverage.
moves.reason: Burst slash is authored as a knockdown.
